title: Choose non-secret settings or secret storage
when: Before adding or changing provider configuration
need: Non-sensitive capability settings are a JSON document; secrets use the capability-owned secret surface. Read before CAS replacement; use merge for one path; never print secret values.
surface: Capabilities guide -> setting help; mistaken scalar settings flags return the correct merge/read/secret recipes.
recipes: yoke projects capability-settings get --project P --cap-type TYPE
